title: WoDX NPC
description: World of Darkness Expanded: NPC profiles, combat tactics, routines and reactions. On an NPC's turn WoDX weighs what it could do from its temperament, fears and the fight, then suggests a plan to the Storyteller or (in Auto) moves and attacks with an undo card. NPCs with a routine keep hour-by-hour places on the Chronicle clock, and WoDX: Reaction regions let watchers notice and react. NPCs who hear a player at work on the map (WoDX Interactables) react through the same card, and a place put on alarm stays so for an hour and wary until dusk, lighting its WoDX: Alert zones. Factions take a turn each week of world time, hunting grounds follow Herd and Domain, and a Masquerade breach spreads as a rumour, every result through the approval queue. WoDX: Trigger regions pass on what happens when someone walks in, and an Alert zone can carry the alarm to other places by bell, telephone, radio or runner. Private use only; not for distribution or sale.
